capabilities: Generates seeded hex maps with terrain, rivers, roads and towns
Keys every hex with contents, rumours and links to notes
Tracks party travel with weather, getting lost, foraging and encounters
Writes per-hex notes and exports the map as a PNG
Embeds Mapsmith blocks for towns and ruins
extras: Free. A browser demo runs the real plugin code. Works offline and sends nothing anywhere. Mapsmith Pro ($6 once) saves towns/dungeons to Foundry, Atlas VTT or Roll20.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate a seeded, keyed hex map and run day-by-day party travel with fog of war inside a note.

relations.evidence: with the free Mapsmith plugin installed, the town's streets or the ruin's dungeon are drawn right there
Foundry VTT: pick one of the Hexagonal Columns grid types (Foundry's flat-topped ones)
Owlbear Rodeo: pick Hex Horizontal (Owlbear's flat-topped grid, point to the right)

summary: Seeded hexcrawl map generator for TTRPGs: terrain, rivers, roads, towns, keyed hexes, fog-of-war party travel with rations and encounters.
